title: Enphase Consumption CT Mismatch
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=enphase:production
| stats avg(consumption_ct_w) as ct_w, avg(home_consumption_w) as home_w by site
| eval pct_diff=round(100*abs(ct_w-home_w)/home_w,1)
| where home_w>0 AND pct_diff>10
| sort - pct_diff
description: Uses Enphase site telemetry telemetry to monitor disagreement between CT-derived and reported home consumption in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sensor or wiring problems that warp downstream dashboards, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Enphase site telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Site table of CT mismatch percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals disagreement between CT-derived and reported home consumption so you can spot sensor or wiring problems that warp downstream dashboards before it becomes annoying.
